_comment: Pre-change assignment baseline for LAT-866, captured from Latitude V2 PRODUCTION ClickHouse. taxonomy_observations is retained 30 days, so these rows no longer exist after 2026-09-16 — this file is the only surviving record of what the 0.65 floor admitted. Reproduce the shape with scripts/taxonomy/snapshot-assignment-baseline.ts.
_floorDecision: 0.81 is the median cluster's own p10 and was the first candidate; the perProjectImpact block below ruled it out. The at-0.81 figures are kept as that evidence, not as the shipped calibration.

byAssignmentMethod._comment: gated = the paths this change adds a floor to. gardening_birth is NOT gated by it (build path, out of scope) yet is the largest population and bottoms lowest — the dominant unfloored hole after this PR.

perProjectImpact._comment: Over the 11 projects with >=50 assignments on a gated path. The fleet number is a tail, not a level: the median project barely moves while the worst loses seven eighths of its assignments.

arms._comment: Exactly one project is on the full-window reassignment path, so change 2's blast radius today is 154 observations/week. Every other project is affected only by the online gate.

fullWindowRouting.note: the narrow-domain ads-analytics pilot, the only adaptive project

sampleOnly.note: every other project; gardening_birth + centroid_online only
